comment: At University of Richmond the band sucks simply due to a lack of participants and focus on the arts overall. Niethamer does the best with what he's given, but if you're expecting a prestigious program that plays good music at a good level, think again.

Music Scenes. Ok, sure hes a nice guy but I think he expects way too much out of people who are really only taking this course because of the requirement. Got a C+ on my first paper because although I answered each question, I "didn't talk about the music" enough. I should have taken this class last year with Hulin...

Doesn't expect a lot from students, is not very demanding at all. Very nice guy. Ensemble is a little weak, so don't join if you're expecting to be playing in an excellent award winning band. Song choices are often not exciting, Niethamer does little to excite students about music, nor pushes them hard to be good musicians. But very nice guy.
